thread:
Priya R: quick ask 0 candidate Maya (L5 SW Eng) accepted verbally. Manager requesting expedited start (2/1) and a one-time retention payment $10k split monthly over 6 months. comp band is ok but retention > standard so needs approval. Need to get routing this week. :pray:
Diego M: copying. Samir, can you confirm headcount and team budget availability?
Samir P: headcount available. Team can fund retention but requires comp-committee + finance ok. candidate relocating; relocation to be processed separately.
Priya R: details for approval: base $180k, RSU standard, retention $10k (monthly x6), proposed start 2026-02-01. Candidate needs signed offer by Fri to coordinate moving.
Kelsey F: finance note 0 any retention > $8k requires comp-committee and CFO visibility. Please include a short biz justification and org impact.
Priya R: will draft justification. Kelsey 0 what should we include?
Kelsey F: include: why this hire is business-critical, time-to-replace estimate, relocation constraints, and that retention is split-pay to reduce cashflow impact. attach manager note + org chart.
Priya R: @Diego can you drop one-liner manager rationale and org chart link?
Diego M: manager rationale: "Candidate brings rare storage-systems experience and will unblock a Q2 launch; replacing would take 4+ months." org chart link: https://drive.redwood/orgcharts/infra-team-v2 (view-only)
Priya R: proposed routing: 1) people-ops review 2) comp-committee 3) CFO sign-off 4) finance payroll setup. Legal also needs to check relocation/employment paperwork.
Samir P: yes add legal (legal@redwood.com) for relocation policy check.
approvals-bot: Approval request AR-2026-478 created. Routing: comp-committee -> CFO. SLA 72h.
approvals-bot: @Kelsey F @Diego M please comment on AR-2026-478 with attachments.
Kelsey F: I'll review this afternoon. If comp-committee approves, CFO loop can happen same day for final sign-off.
Priya R: small tweak 0 manager can accept a fallback start date of 2/15 if approvals slide; will include fallback language in offer.
Diego M: agreed, include 2/15 fallback.
Priya R: submitted AR-2026-478 with manager note + org chart + proposed offer language. will update here when we get comp-committee response. :v:
